explanation: Accumulate the source digits into an integer, then recursively emit its digits in the destination base. The recursive string concatenations copy growing prefixes.
timeComplexity: O(s+t²), for s source digits and t output digits
spaceComplexity: O(s+t) live character storage and O(t) recursion depth
